info.title: bibiz_memberapi - V1
info.description:
Authentication & Security

API Documentation & Authentication Flow

This API requires two headers for authentication:

1) API Key Authentication

- Every request must include an API Key in the header.
- Example: Authorization-Key: your-api-key

2) Login Token Authentication

- Call /MobileProfile/ProfileLogin with member login credentials to get a Authorization.
- Example: Authorization: your-token

API Documentation

The API documentation can be accessed here.

Authentication Flow

1) Pass the API Key (Authorization-Key) in the header.
2) Call /MobileProfile/ProfileLogin to get Authorization.
3) Use Authorization in the header for secure API calls.

PointToCashRate(This property represents how much cash is equivalent to a single point. )
For example, if the value of this property is "0.010", it means that 1 point is equivalent to 0.010 units of cash.
